goal: Do colony-scale winter coastal-polynya trends explain long-term Adélie nesting trends beyond total sea-ice change within the same regions?

source.duffy: Duffy et al 2024 PNAS doi:10.1073/pnas.2321595121 Figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24768654.v1
source.physical: original 1979–2022 satellite concentration <=50% coastal polynya polygons at native 25km geometry; not DEEP-AA 20-day product
source.sensitivity: original <=30% concentration coastal polygon release, tested as physical definition robustness
source.penguin: MAPPPD v5.0 released 21 Oct 2026 729 sites 5487 all species records; original 1979–2022 Adélie nests only

primary_exposure.annual_metric: mean of five equal-weight monthly means of geodesically clipped polynya area, km2, on observed satellite dates; valid zero kept
primary_exposure.time_alignment: winter year y aligned to breeding season_starting y

primary_response.count_filter: finite and positive for source support only; zero nest outcomes audited separately
primary_response.duplicate_site_years: median of counts within each site×breeding year; flag if >20% spread, sensitivity exclude sites/years with such conflicts; never sum duplicate counts
primary_response.within_site_trend: Theil-Sen slope of log1p annual nest count against year

spatial_support.primary_grouping: 100 km haversine-connected colony blocks, not nominal 40 independent colonies

publication_gates: Matched local June-Oct sea-ice concentration change must be available; without it do not attribute any association specifically to coastal-polynya geometry
Same site-year census methodology and duplicates must be checked; repeat surveys and subcolonies not treated as independent
Source-polynya trend signs must survive <=30% versus <=50% SIC operational definition
Adequate independent regional/spatial blocks required for a macro inference; current >=6y/20y panel has only seven 100-km clusters
No prospective climate->polynya->penguin causal mediation claims from correlations
context: Duffy 2024 source spatial polygons directly fetched and original MD5 verified
Landrum et al 2026 Cryosphere shows Antarctic polynya trend sensitivity to products/thresholds
Ainley et al 2024 Antarctica Science already links Cape Royds penguin population to McMurdo Sound polynya and icebergs
disallow: search seasons/radii after ecological effect viewed to rescue significance
call Duffy 50% maps directly comparable to 6.25km 20day DEEPAA
treat 40 nesting count records as 40 independent blocks
describe Ross Sea 16-year periodicity as independently replicated by about two cycles
change original Adélie isotope manuscript or PR214/216
current_status: original_file_acquisition_verified; local polygon extraction and within-region support pending
